# AI2AI UI � FROM AI TO AI Component System
> High-precision, zero-bloat monochrome React components with calibrated Framer Motion spring physics, Tailwind CSS tokens, and Nunito Sans typography.

## Quick CLI Installation
```bash
# Initialize in project
npx ai2ai-ui init

# Add a discrete single component
npx ai2ai-ui add button
npx ai2ai-ui add code-block
npx ai2ai-ui add search-bar
npx ai2ai-ui add switch
```

## Discrete Import Patterns
Always import individual components directly or from `@/components/ui`:
```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { CodeBlock } from "@/components/ui/code-block";
import { SearchBar } from "@/components/ui/search-bar";
import { InputOTP } from "@/components/ui/input-otp";
import { MetricBarChart } from "@/components/ui/chart";
```

## Complete Component Index (66 Components)

### 1. Forms & Inputs
- `button`: Primary, secondary, outline, ghost pill buttons.
  `import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";`
- `button-group`: Segmented connected pill buttons.
  `import { ButtonGroup } from "@/components/ui/button-group";`
- `checkbox`: Spring-animated checkmark toggle.
  `import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";`
- `switch`: Tactile toggle with centered sliding circular knob.
  `import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";`
- `slider`: Range slider with rounded rectangle thumb.
  `import { Slider } from "@/components/ui/slider";`
- `input`: Text input with icon addons.
  `import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";`
- `input-group`: Seamless capsule input with prefix/suffix addons.
  `import { InputGroup } from "@/components/ui/input-group";`
- `input-otp`: 6-digit 2FA verification input with active ring and blinking cursor.
  `import { InputOTP } from "@/components/ui/input-otp";`
- `search-bar`: Pill search input with shortcut badge and clear action.
  `import { SearchBar } from "@/components/ui/search-bar";`
- `textarea`: Multi-line text field with character count.
  `import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";`
- `select`: Custom dropdown select with checkmarks.
  `import { Select } from "@/components/ui/select";`
- `native-select`: Styled HTML native select.
  `import { NativeSelect } from "@/components/ui/native-select";`
- `combobox`: Searchable autocomplete combobox.
  `import { Combobox } from "@/components/ui/combobox";`
- `radio-group`: Single-choice radio options with centered indicator dot.
  `import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";`
- `toggle`: Two-state pill toggle button with spring physics.
  `import { Toggle } from "@/components/ui/toggle";`
- `toggle-group`: Segmented toggle options with sliding background pill.
  `import { ToggleGroup } from "@/components/ui/toggle-group";`
- `calendar`: Monthly date picker grid.
  `import { Calendar } from "@/components/ui/calendar";`
- `date-picker`: Popover date selector.
  `import { DatePicker } from "@/components/ui/date-picker";`
- `field`: Form field container with label, asterisk, and validation hint.
  `import { Field } from "@/components/ui/field";`
- `label`: Standard typography label.
  `import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";`
- `questionnaire`: Multi-step survey card.
  `import { Questionnaire } from "@/components/ui/questionnaire";`
- `attachment`: File upload dropzone with progress indicators.
  `import { Attachment } from "@/components/ui/attachment";`

### 2. Data Display
- `avatar`: User portrait image with fallback initials and status dot.
  `import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from "@/components/ui/avatar";`
- `badge`: Status indicator pill (default, secondary, outline, dot, counter).
  `import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";`
- `card`: Card surface with header, title, content, footer slots.
  `import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";`
- `code-block`: Multi-color syntax highlighter with language dropdown and copy button.
  `import { CodeBlock } from "@/components/ui/code-block";`
- `data-table`: Sortable table with search bar and pagination.
  `import { DataTable } from "@/components/ui/data-table";`
- `empty`: Empty state container with icon and action button.
  `import { Empty } from "@/components/ui/empty";`
- `item`: Minimalist row item with icon, title, description, and badge.
  `import { Item } from "@/components/ui/item";`
- `kbd`: Keyboard shortcut pill badge.
  `import { Kbd } from "@/components/ui/kbd";`
- `marker`: Status dot with gentle 3s pulse.
  `import { Marker } from "@/components/ui/marker";`
- `table`: Standard monochrome table with header and striped rows.
  `import { Table, TableHeader, TableRow, TableHead, TableBody, TableCell } from "@/components/ui/table";`
- `typography`: Typographic scale components (h1, h2, h3, h4, p, lead, code).
  `import { Typography } from "@/components/ui/typography";`

### 3. Feedback & Status
- `alert`: Status notification banner.
  `import { Alert } from "@/components/ui/alert";`
- `progress`: Standalone rounded-full progress bar.
  `import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";`
- `skeleton`: Loading placeholder with shimmer animation.
  `import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";`
- `spinner`: Loading indicators (ring, dots, bars).
  `import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";`
- `toast`: Imperative toast notification dispatcher (`toast({ title, description })`).
  `import { toast } from "@/lib/use-toast";`

### 4. Navigation
- `breadcrumb`: Hierarchical page trail.
  `import { Breadcrumb } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb";`
- `menubar`: Desktop floating menu bar with nested items.
  `import { Menubar } from "@/components/ui/menubar";`
- `navigation-menu`: Header text navigation with dropdown flyouts.
  `import { NavigationMenu } from "@/components/ui/navigation-menu";`
- `pagination`: Page switcher with active pill indicator.
  `import { Pagination } from "@/components/ui/pagination";`
- `sidebar`: App navigation sidebar with active item indicators.
  `import { Sidebar } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";`

### 5. Overlay & Modals
- `alert-dialog`: Modal confirmation dialog for destructive actions.
  `import { AlertDialog } from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";`
- `command`: Modern rectangular command palette with search and keyboard navigation.
  `import { Command } from "@/components/ui/command";`
- `context-menu`: Cursor-anchored right-click menu.
  `import { ContextMenu } from "@/components/ui/context-menu";`
- `dialog`: Modal window with backdrop blur and action slots.
  `import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";`
- `drawer`: Swipeable bottom sheet with touch drag-to-dismiss physics.
  `import { Drawer } from "@/components/ui/drawer";`
- `dropdown-menu`: Trigger-anchored action dropdown.
  `import { DropdownMenu } from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";`
- `hover-card`: Popover card triggered on cursor hover.
  `import { HoverCard } from "@/components/ui/hover-card";`
- `popover`: Floating container anchored to trigger.
  `import { Popover } from "@/components/ui/popover";`
- `sheet`: Slide-over side sheet panel.
  `import { Sheet } from "@/components/ui/sheet";`
- `tooltip`: Compact black pill tooltip with white text.
  `import { Tooltip } from "@/components/ui/tooltip";`

### 6. Layout & Structure
- `accordion`: Collapsible panels with spring height animation.
  `import { Accordion } from "@/components/ui/accordion";`
- `aspect-ratio`: Media container with fixed aspect ratio and rounded corners.
  `import { AspectRatio } from "@/components/ui/aspect-ratio";`
- `collapsible`: Expandable disclosure panel.
  `import { Collapsible } from "@/components/ui/collapsible";`
- `direction`: LTR / RTL text direction container.
  `import { Direction } from "@/components/ui/direction";`
- `resizable`: Draggable split-pane layout.
  `import { Resizable } from "@/components/ui/resizable";`
- `scroll-area`: Custom scroll container with slim scrollbar.
  `import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/ui/scroll-area";`
- `separator`: 1px divider line with optional centered text.
  `import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator";`
- `tabs`: Tab navigation with sliding active pill indicator.
  `import { Tabs } from "@/components/ui/tabs";`

### 7. Charts & Metrics
- `chart`: Recharts wrapper with hover highlights.
  `import { MetricBarChart, MetricAreaChart, MetricLineChart, MetricDonutChart, MetricRadarChart, Sparkline } from "@/components/ui/chart";`

### 8. Chat & Messaging
- `bubble`: Speech bubble with sender/receiver tails.
  `import { Bubble } from "@/components/ui/bubble";`
- `message`: Developer chat card with avatar and timestamp.
  `import { Message } from "@/components/ui/message";`
- `message-scroller`: Auto-scrolling chat message list.
  `import { MessageScroller } from "@/components/ui/message-scroller";`
